newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ, Postbank cut NZ fixed home lending rates.
newsitem.headline: ANZ, Postbank cut NZ fixed home lending rates.

text.p: New Zealand's ANZ and Postbank on Thursday cut their fixed home lending rates across the board, leaving the variable rate unchanged at 9.4 percent.
Earlier on Thursday both ASB Bank and National announced falls in their fixed mortgage rates.
ANZ and Postbank's one-year fixed rate falls to 8.25 percent from 8.5 percent.
The two and three year rates fall to 8.75 percent from 9.2 and 9.5 percent respectively, while the five year fixed rate drops to 9.25 percent from 9.7 percent.
The banks' six month fixed rate falls to 8.2 percent from 8.35 percent.
The new rates are effective from June 20.
